A14.value: Last year used U 0.30 dual and 0.22 triple with no SHGC. Dividers lower SHGC; over half of Marvin sales include some type of divider (Kevin).

A15.value: Window code limits (2024 IECC Table R402.1.3, linked from IECC Reference tab)

A2.value: Placeholder values from Kevin's email (10/10/2026). All insulating glass argon filled. Final spreadsheet (and operator vs. picture split) to come before the design review.

A24.value: Checks use the no-divider SHGC. Dividers lower SHGC (column E), so a divider version can meet a limit its plain version misses. NR = no requirement. Code also allows area-weighted averages and trade-offs; this check is per window, like the wall check.

C4.value: Interpolate = fit results vs. SHGC and read off divider values (no extra runs). Simulate = doubles window options.

C5.value: Y = each city simulates only the window options that meet its 2024 IECC limits (columns G-L). N = all window options, with code status flagged.
